summary.text: Slumbering Lightning Python is one of refinement path's four publicly recognized strongest immortal killer moves for processing immortal materials.

claims.text: While refining in Star Form blessed land, Fang Yuan names the four publicly recognized strongest immortal killer moves that can process difficult immortal materials instantly: slumbering lightning python, reflect snow, muffled thunder stone drum, and wind grind. He does not have any of the four, so earthly limit astral qi costs him long effort instead.

Lang Ya land spirit shouts the move’s name. Lightning bolts flash and interweave into a huge dragon-like lightning python. Lightning is yang and python is yin, so the python holds both, curbing lightning’s wild nature into a graceful, lovely form that coils around mountain-like elephant armor rock and crushes it to fine powder. Among those four strongest refinement path processing moves, this one is elevated to rank eight with rank eight refinement path Immortal Gu, and without that rank eight form they could not process the rank eight information path immemorial immortal material elephant armor mountain.

Four Elements Square Regret Blood Refinement Pool can utilize this refinement path killer move among others, including wind grind, reflect snow, muffled thunder stone drum, dragon-shaped blizzard, refinement snake lifespan flower, heavenly light ring, and omnipresent four seas.
